title: Sunday · the Grunion Run, 2011
logline: The run in three tiers with the fish taking all of them, silver and thick this year, and the people at the edges of the page. The dog, twelve, sits it out on the sand.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the surf line thick with silver fish, lantern light on them.

panels.name: Thick

panels.composition: Tier 2: people bent at the page's edges, the fish the whole middle.

panels.name: Edges

panels.composition: Tier 3: an old dog sitting on the sand above the tide line, watching.
